about_the_game: Star Pulse: War is a real-time strategy independent game that combines science fiction and fantasy. Players will play as sci-fi forces, collecting resources, building buildings, producing troops, researching and developing technology, cultivating heroes, and customizing super units. In the process of using star veins to resist the invasion of magical side forces, identify the root of the war.

short_description: Star Pulse: The War is an independent real-time strategy game that merges science fiction with fantasy. Players will command a sci-fi faction, harnessing the power of star pulse to gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and nurture heroes in the fight against invading magical forces.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
